propositions: Re-reviewing a plan whose latest verdict is BLOCK with blocking findings should print a warn-only message if the plan's description component fingerprint is unchanged and at least one cited anchor is still present verbatim, without declining the review or changing exit code.

A deterministic pre-check must compare current plan material against anchors recorded in the blocking review's sidecar; it should warn only when all matched anchors remain untouched and the description fingerprint is unchanged.

Cited anchors that cannot be matched verbatim (paraphrased evidence or structural findings with no quote) must never trigger the warning alone; the warning fires only when at least one anchor is matched and all matched anchors are untouched.
The review sidecar metrics block must record the cited-anchor warning flag (true or false) on every plan review to enable offline measurement of warning hit rate and predictive value per ADR 0054.
